name: studio-viseme-chart
description: Project viseme chart: maps phonemes and coarticulation contexts to mouth shapes. Used by the lipsync commands (tools-anim.py). Edit this file to match a project-specific mouth set; the commands never hardcode shapes.

rules: closed consonants (MBP) hold for at least 2 frames when surrounded by vowels
adjacent vowels blend via the intermediate narrower viseme
fast speech (>4 phonemes/sec) may drop intermediate visemes to key contacts
keep expression channels (brows, lids) independent of the mouth track

notes: approx_open_mapping is used when only audio energy/onset timing is available (no phoneme recognizer installed); those tracks are marked approx:true and require visual review.
